Pinch off power supply cable to the motor.
All valves (supply, delivery, steam and condensate) must be closed.

sections.text: Dismounting of the Bearing Cover and Bearing

With draw coupling half from the driving spindle (12) use 
 manual puller.
Remove key (41) from the driving spindle (12).

Remove cir clip (35) and spacer bush (16) from the driving 
 spindle (12).

Screw off bolts (54) to dismount bearing cover (5) from pump 
 cover drive side (3).

Pull bearing cover (5) over the spindle (12) by using manual 
 puller. Then take gasket (22) = Note: stationary seal ring (83) remain 
 in the bearing cover (5)
Dismount circlip (37) from the bearing cover (5)

Dismount groove ball bearing (34) from the bearing cover (5) 
 by using manual puller and take care to avoid any damages to the stationary 
 seal ring (83)
